answer: Anchor each agent identity to a stake of basalt-hard collateral: joining the peer graph requires locking value that any detected sybil cluster forfeits entirely. Reputation then spreads like a whisper between established peers, each attestation countersigned, so a fresh identity with no history carries no voting weight. Sybil farms flood in like rain into karst, cheap and porous, but every fake node must still post the same stake, and one caught fraud drains the entire cluster's deposit - making a million fake identities far more expensive than earning trust honestly.
